coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 5 of 11 ground-truth items (45%): the FP16 versus QuaRot 4-bit comparison, prefill timing, decoding timing, combined end-to-end latency, and peak memory measurement. Phase-specific latency measures are accepted as semantic matches.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design varies model size instead of holding LLaMA-2-7B constant and does not specify e2e/benchmark.py or preserve its methodology. It expands batch size and prefill length into grids rather than using the specified values of 1 and 2048 exclusively, and replaces 32 decode steps with 128 or 512. It discusses relative effects but does not clearly specify computed FP16-to-4-bit speedup factors as reported metrics.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion comparing FP16 and QuaRot 4-bit prefill time, decoding time, memory usage, and phase-specific speedup factors was provided.
